error.message: No catalog is loaded yet. The router has started but has not finished reading the mounted document, so it has nothing to answer from and no catalog_version to report - there is nothing to hash. This is the TRANSIENT case only: the same request will succeed unchanged once the load completes, which is why the obligation is retry. A catalog the router loaded and then refused because its schema_version is one this build does not implement is a different code, catalog_schema_unsupported, precisely because retrying that one forever is the wrong behaviour. No endpoint is named: this envelope is served from every endpoint, and a shared fixture that claimed one would teach a caller the wrong error path for its own call.
